name: Bb ballad walk
desc: Slow Bb major ballad walk: half-note two-feel in sparse, quarter walk with chromatic approach tones in full, 8-bar turnaround with passing eighths at peak.

code.full: note("<[bb1 d2 f2 g2] [g1 bb1 d2 eb2] [c2 eb2 g2 a2] [f1 a1 c2 e2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.75, ${cut}*1.15).slow(24)).shape(${drive}).attack(.012).decay(.25).sustain(.4).release(.2).clip(.9).gain(${gain}).room(.3).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[bb1 d2 f2 g2] [g1 bb1 d2 eb2] [c2 eb2 g2 a2] [f1 [a1 b1] c2 eb2] [bb1 d2 f2 f#2] [g1 b1 d2 f2] [c2 e2 g2 [a2 ab2]] [f1 a1 c2 e2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).shape(${drive}).attack(.01).decay(.22).sustain(.35).release(.18).clip(.9).gain(${gain}).room(.28).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
